## Description

**What**: Implement the `<<inferred:source-name>>` structural marker emission and rendering: orchestrator wraps inferred input source mentions in markers at spec-drafting time; phases/approval-gate.md contains a bold rendering rule placed inline with the approval-gate render step that converts markers to bold.

**Why**: This is the visual surfacing mechanism that lets users review inferred input sources at approval time. Bot-psychologist re-review confirmed structural markers eliminate text-match brittleness vs. the prior text-propagation design.

**Scope**:
- IN: Orchestrator instruction (in plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md Phase 2 Step 2) to wrap inferred input source noun phrases with `<<inferred:source-name>>` per the contract doc; bold rendering rule placed inline with the approval-gate render step in plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md; renderer converts `<<inferred:...>>` markers to bold; high/critical assumption findings in `## Scenario Analysis` rendered in bold.
- OUT: The contract doc itself (covered by S4); historical-spec backfill (per contract scope decision).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md Phase 2 Step 2 instructs the orchestrator to wrap inferred input source mentions in `<<inferred:source-name>>` markers per the contract at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md, verified by structural test asserting the canonical reference and instruction phrasing are present.
  ← Satisfies: "Schema, marker, and rendering integration"
- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md contains a bold rendering rule placed inline with the approval-gate render step that converts `<<inferred:...>>` markers to bold, verified by structural test asserting the rule is co-located with the render step (not in a separate section).
  ← Satisfies: "Schema, marker, and rendering integration"
- When this story is complete, surviving assumption-category findings of severity `high` or `critical` render in bold at the approval gate, verified by structural test asserting the rendering rule for severity-based bolding is present.
  ← Satisfies: "Schema, marker, and rendering integration"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] phases/approval-gate.md is also touched by epics c183-ed2a (provenance bolding for inferred SCs), 7ac3-71a1 (optional human review), 6f33-2392 (design review references), a154-98de (PRECONDITIONS bash blocks); coordinate merge ordering with later-landing epic rebasing.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a brainstorm user reviewing the approval gate, inferred input source mentions are visually flagged
